Preliminary version for the project team. Results may change as the study progresses. English translation under review. If the two versions differ, the Portuguese text prevails.
``` ::: ::: ## Objective The second specific objective (SO2) is to build a database on the technical and economic performance of family production systems in the pilot areas. It measures costs, profitability, employment and income to identify low-carbon practices that are financially viable, meaning that they can cover their own costs. These results will also underpin the recommendations of the Technology Package. **Methods.** The proposal combines secondary data from censuses and public registers with a field survey in the pilot areas. The survey will use structured questionnaires and interviews on agricultural practices, costs, productivity, employment and income. ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
Status as at 19 October 2026: in progress
  • completed Municipal snapshot of family farming in Mato Grosso, covering all 141 municipalities (IBGE, 2017 Agricultural Census).
  • completed Municipal typology of family farming from Manuscript 1 (five types, with provisional labels). Manuscript being revised by the authors.
  • planned Field survey in the pilot areas. No confirmed date: this depends on the Research Ethics Committee approving the questionnaire.
  • planned Performance database by pilot area, and a socioeconomic and production assessment report.

The badges are based on the project’s internal record and have yet to be validated by the project coordination team.
